content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The jj-sourced set is where the enumeration meets the change listing, the owning-change identity, the one layout and the read it must agree with; the gate forces the set to answer to all of them without re-deciding the query or how a document is read. Its four edges span two cells — three prose parents (natural→natural) and one artifact parent (code→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
